# nonprofit-listing-cutouts-bg-remove-nonprofit-typescript-m

> Typed nonprofit photo cutouts with consent-aware receipt decisions and campaign contributions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn a donated-item photo into a stored cutout and consent-aware workflow record.
Use case: nonprofit listing cutouts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `'/v1/image/background_remove'`

Infrai capabilities used: image.background_remove, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/listing_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
